ancestries.name: Anadi
ancestries.description: Peaceful, reclusive spider-people who can shift between humanoid and giant spider forms, hiding their true nature from a world that fears them.

ancestries.name: Android
ancestries.description: Artificial beings created with synthetic flesh and mechanical components, capable of experiencing human emotions while possessing inhuman durability.

ancestries.name: Automaton
ancestries.description: Ancient clockwork beings powered by a fragment of a forgotten deity's spark, awakening after millennia to find a world that has moved on without them.

ancestries.name: Azarketi
ancestries.description: Aquatic humanoids adapted to life beneath the waves, with gills and webbed features, who can survive on land but long for the sea.

ancestries.name: Conrasu
ancestries.description: Mysterious beings of cosmic order made of glowing aeon shards contained within exoskeletons of their own construction, seeking purpose in the mortal world.

ancestries.name: Fetchling
ancestries.description: Shadow-touched humans who dwell in the Plane of Shadow, with pale skin, dark hair, and the ability to blend seamlessly into darkness.

ancestries.name: Fleshwarp
ancestries.description: Beings twisted by alchemy, magic, or planar energies into monstrous new forms, struggling to find acceptance in a world that sees them as abominations.

ancestries.name: Ghoran
ancestries.description: Sentient plants grown from alchemically created seeds, reborn anew each generation with fragmented memories of their past lives.

ancestries.name: Goloma
ancestries.description: Horse-sized, multi-eyed creatures covered in chitinous plates, whose many eyes see in all directions and whose culture is defined by deep paranoia.

ancestries.name: Grippli
ancestries.description: Small, tree-dwelling frog-people with colorful skin, leaping ability, and a deep connection to jungle environments.

ancestries.name: Kashrishi
ancestries.description: Small, psychic rhinoceros-beetle-people with crystalline horns that allow them to sense and manipulate mental energies.

ancestries.name: Nagaji
ancestries.description: Serpentine humanoids with scaly skin and snake-like lower bodies, descended from the servants of forgotten snake deities.

ancestries.name: Poppet
ancestries.description: Stuffed dolls, wooden mannequins, or other crafted toys brought to life by accident, magic, or a child's love.

ancestries.name: Samsaran
ancestries.description: Pale-skinned, blue-veined humanoids who reincarnate across multiple lifetimes, retaining fragments of their past existences.

ancestries.name: Shisk
ancestries.description: Hedgehog-porcupine humanoids covered in quills, guardians of ancient secrets who live in underground warrens.

ancestries.name: Skeleton
ancestries.description: Undead skeletons animated by necromantic magic or lingering will, clattering through unlife with bones held together by dark forces.

ancestries.name: Sprite
ancestries.description: Tiny fey creatures with butterfly wings, glowing with primal magic and barely a foot tall.

ancestries.name: Strix
ancestries.description: Winged humanoids who dwell on mountain peaks, shunned by land-bound civilizations and gifted with the power of flight.

ancestries.name: Vanara
ancestries.description: Monkey-folk with prehensile tails, curious and mischievous, who love climbing, scavenging, and collecting trinkets.
